title: Embeddings of a normal algebraic extension differ by an automorphism
statement: Let $L/k$ be an algebraic normal field extension [def-pc-field-extension], where normal means that the minimal polynomial over $k$ of each element of $L$ splits into linear factors in $L[T]$. Let $E/k$ be any field extension and fix a $k$-embedding $\tau:L\hookrightarrow E$. For every $k$-embedding $\rho:L\hookrightarrow E$, there is a $k$-automorphism $\sigma$ of $L$ such that $\rho=\tau\circ\sigma$. No separability or finite-degree assumption is imposed.
